g.text: Participation geography persists across election levels

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Each tract is measured against its election’s citizen-18+-weighted Toronto rate; the shared scale makes local gaps directly comparable.
Notes: Participation is estimated votes divided by the 2021 Census citizen population age 18+. Two tracts lack observed outcomes and appear gray.
Federal ratios above 1 are retained but outlined because interpolated votes can exceed the census denominator. Ward lines provide orientation.
Sources: final observed CT variables; canonical 2021 CT geometry; City of Toronto ward geometry.
